blob: from process to performance : tailoring materials in laser-based additive manufacturing and processing powder bed fusion – laser beam (pbf – lb) has emerged as an effective method for producing metallic components with complex geometries. beyond its capability as a shaping technology, the process introduces unique thermal conditions that strongly influence microstructural evolution. these characteristics present both challenges and opportunities, as rapid solidification and cyclic reheating can lead to unwanted defects and non-equilibrium microstructures, while also paving new pathways for tailor 该论文涉及激光粉末床熔融ti-6al-4v合金的后处理（热等静压、氮辅助处理），但重点不在疲劳性能，因此部分相关。 this thesis covers multiple alloy systems and processing strategies; it does not provide a dedicated, quantitative study of post-processing effects on fatigue life of ti-6al-4v. 探索激光增材制造作为调控材料性能的工具。 结合成分改性、工艺策略和后处理（热等静压、氮助处理）对ti-6al-4v进行微观结构和性能调控。 实现了从马氏体α'向β-rich微观结构的转变，形成梯度组织和硬质氮化物表面层，改善了耐磨性和力学响应。 通过力学测试和摩擦学实验验证了性能改善。 pbf-lb ti-6al-4v post-processing hot isostatic pressing surface engineering mechanical performance composite powder mixing laser rescanning powder bed fusion – laser beam 粉末床熔融-激光束 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v合金 hot isostatic pressing 热等静压 post-processing 后处理 microstructure tailoring 微观结构调控 mechanical performance 力学性能 wear resistance 耐磨性 surface engineering 表面工程 laser rescanning 激光重扫描 vidhiaza leviandhika uppsala university publications (uppsala university)

blob: influence of post-processing temperatures on microstructure and hardness of pbf-lb ti-6al-4v this study investigates the effects of post-build heat treatments—such as annealing, quenching, and aging—on the microstructure and hardness of laser powder bed fusion (pbf-lb) ti-6al-4v. specimens were subjected to annealing (950 °c, 1010 °c) or solution treatment/quenching (950 °c, 1010 °c), followed by aging (350–550 °c). microstructural evolution was analyzed using optical microscopy (om), scanning electron microscopy (sem), x-ray diffraction (xrd), electron backscatter diffraction (ebsd), a 该论文直接研究了ti-6al-4v后处理热处理对显微硬度和微观结构的影响，但未涉及疲劳或拉伸性能。 no fatigue or tensile testing data, only hardness; lacks porosity closure analysis. 探究后处理热处理温度对选区激光熔化ti-6al-4v显微组织与硬度的影响。 对试样进行退火、淬火及时效处理，通过om、sem、xrd、ebsd及维氏硬度测试表征。 淬火后时效在450°c获得最高硬度382.6 hv0.1，归因于析出强化；退火降低硬度，粗大层状结构硬度最低。 通过硬度测试和微观结构表征验证热处理效果。 pbf-lb ti-6al-4v heat treatment microstructure hardness annealing quenching aging phase transformation laser powder bed fusion 激光粉末床熔融 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v post-processing heat treatment 后处理热处理 annealing 退火 quenching 淬火 aging 时效 microstructure 微观结构 vickers hardness 维氏硬度 martensite 马氏体 precipitation hardening 析出强化 trung van trinh, trang huyen dang, anh hoang pham, gia khanh pham, ulrich e. klotz metals school of materials science and engineering, hanoi university of science and technology, no. 1 dai co viet, hanoi 100000, vietnam

blob: predicting stress-strain behaviors of additively manufactured materials via loss-based and activation-based physics-informed machine learning predicting the stress-strain behaviors of additively manufactured materials is crucial for part qualification in additive manufacturing (am). conventional physics-based constitutive models often oversimplify material properties, while data-driven machine learning (ml) models often lack physical consistency and interpretability. to address these issues, we propose a physics-informed machine learning (piml) framework to improve the predictive performance and physical consistency for predicting the 该论文提出了一种物理信息机器学习框架，可预测ti6al4v等增材制造材料的应力-应变行为，但其主要贡献在于方法而非ti6al4v的力学性能本身。 the paper does not provide new experimental data or insights specific to ti-6al-4v mechanical or fatigue characterization; it presents a general predictive framework tested on multiple materials including ti6al4v. 传统本构模型和纯数据驱动模型在预测增材制造材料应力-应变行为时各有局限。 提出基于物理信息机器学习（piml）的分段预测框架，弹性段嵌入胡克定律，塑性段嵌入voce或hollomon硬化律，采用lstm模型分别预测。 激活式piml架构在包括ti6al4v在内的四种材料数据集上取得最低mape 10.46%和最高r² 0.82。 使用尼龙、碳纤维abs、alsi10mg和ti6al4v四种增材制造材料的实验数据进行验证。 physics-informed machine learning stress-strain prediction ti6al4v lstm additive manufacturing physics-informed machine learning 物理信息机器学习 stress-strain curve 应力-应变曲线 ti6al4v ti6al4v long short-term memory 长短期记忆网络 additive manufacturing 增材制造 voce hardening law voce硬化律 hollomon's law hollomon定律 chaorui duan, dazhong wu arxiv (cornell university)

blob: fatigue life prediction of tc4 titanium alloy bolted structures in thermal environments below 400 °c using an enhanced dfr method tc4 titanium alloy bolted structures are extensively utilized in aerospace engineering, particularly within the heat-affected zones of aircraft engines. however, current studies have predominantly focused on fatigue fracture of titanium alloys at temperatures exceeding 400 °c, leaving a gap in accurate fatigue life prediction for tc4 bolted structures subjected to moderate elevated temperatures up to 400 °c. to address this limitation, this study proposes an enhanced detail fatigue rating (dfr)  该论文直接针对增材制造ti-6al-4v的疲劳性能，提出了增强型dfr方法用于螺栓结构在热环境下的寿命预测，与l1方向高度相关。 it is not primarily about additive manufacturing; the ti-6al-4v material is conventionally produced, not additively manufactured. 解决400°c以下热环境中tc4螺栓结构疲劳寿命预测不准确的问题 基于基础材料疲劳实验数据，建立考虑温度影响的增强型dfr方法 增强dfr方法在20~400°c范围内将平均疲劳寿命预测精度提高9.29% 通过tc4螺栓双剪结构疲劳实验验证预测精度 tc4 titanium alloy fatigue life prediction dfr method bolted structures thermal environment tc4 titanium alloy tc4钛合金 fatigue life prediction 疲劳寿命预测 detail fatigue rating (dfr) 细节疲劳额定值(dfr) bolted structures 螺栓结构 thermal environment 热环境 enhanced dfr method 增强型dfr方法 experimental validation 实验验证 hang peng, bintuan wang, jianbo qin, shiyu li, yan zhou materials avic the first aircraft institute, xi’an 710089, china

blob: synergistic effect of hydroxyapatite-titania nanocomposites derived from machining waste on the corrosion resistance of ti6al4v implants abstract in this study, hydroxyapatite (ha) was synthesized via the sol–gel method and characterized to ensure phase purity and nanoparticle formation. titanium machining chips were recycled and transformed into nanopowder using planetary ball milling to enhance material sustainability. composite coatings of ha–tio 2 were subsequently deposited onto ti6al4v alloy substrates through electrophoretic deposition (epd) at a constant voltage of 45 v for 90 s, with ha contents of 10, 20, 30, and 40 wt% 该论文涉及ti6al4v合金的涂层处理，但未关注增材制造ti-6al-4v的疲劳或力学性能，且未涉及后处理对机械性能的影响。 not about additively manufactured ti-6al-4v; focus on corrosion resistance of coated wrought ti6al4v, not mechanical performance or fatigue; no post-processing for fatigue enhancement. 回收钛加工废料制备生物相容涂层，提高ti6al4v植入物的耐腐蚀性。 溶胶-凝胶合成羟基磷灰石，球磨回收钛屑，电泳沉积ha-tio2复合涂层，真空烧结。 含30wt% ha的涂层在模拟体液中耐腐蚀性能最佳。 通过sem、xrd、eis和极化曲线进行微观结构和电化学表征。 hydroxyapatite-titania coating corrosion resistance ti6al4v electrophoretic deposition hydroxyapatite 羟基磷灰石 titania 二氧化钛 electrophoretic deposition 电泳沉积 corrosion resistance 耐腐蚀性 ti6al4v ti6al4v合金 machining waste 加工废料 majid kavanlouei, mehrdad shahbaz, seyyed amir reza alavizadeh, amir ahmadi khoshalani scientific reports department of materials science and engineering, faculty of engineering, urmia university, urmia, 5756151818, iran. m.kavanlouei@urmia.ac.ir

blob: microstructural and phase evolution of ti-6al-4v alloy produced by laser powder bed fusion (lpbf) under electron irradiation in this paper, the microstructural, chemical, and phase evolution of a ti-6al-4v alloy fabricated by laser powder bed fusion (lpbf) and subsequently subjected to electron irradiation was investigated. the lpbf process results in the formation of a nonequilibrium microstructure under rapid solidification conditions (≈10⁵–10⁶ k/s), including acicular α′-martensite, oriented prior β grains, and microporosity (≈0.2–1.0 μm). scanning electron microscopy (sem), energy-dispersive spectroscopy (eds), an 论文研究了电子辐照对lpbf ti-6al-4v微观结构和相演变的影响，但未涉及力学或疲劳性能，与用户关注的力学/疲劳方向关联较弱。 the paper reports only microstructural, chemical, and phase evolution after electron irradiation, with no tensile, fatigue, hardness, or any mechanical property data. 研究电子辐照对lpbf ti-6al-4v微观结构和相演变的影响。 采用sem、eds和xrd表征辐照前后的显微组织、化学成分和物相。 辐照导致团聚体增大、孔隙减小、ti含量下降及晶格膨胀。 通过sem、eds和xrd实验数据进行验证。 ti-6al-4v laser powder bed fusion electron irradiation microstructure phase evolution xrd sem laser powder bed fusion 激光粉末床熔融 electron irradiation 电子辐照 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v合金 martensite 马氏体 lattice parameters 晶格参数 residual stress 残余应力 x-ray diffraction x射线衍射 scanning electron microscopy 扫描电子显微镜 energy-dispersive spectroscopy 能量色散谱 yerik merkibayev, т.а. чепуштанова, bauyrzhan bazarbay, arailym berlibek, kulzira mamyrbaeva acta metallurgica slovaca satbayev universitet

blob: wire arc additive manufacturing for lightweight material applications: a systematic literature review wire arc additive manufacturing (waam) is increasingly used to fabricate large lightweight metal components because it combines wire feedstock, arc-based heat sources, high deposition rate, and high material utilization. this systematic literature review evaluates recent progress in waam for aluminum, titanium, and magnesium alloys, with emphasis on process parameters, microstructure, mechanical properties, defects, and industrial applications. the review followed the prisma 2020 framework and s 该综述覆盖了waam工艺参数及缺陷，但未聚焦ti-6al-4v的后处理对疲劳/力学性能的影响。 this is a broad systematic review covering waam for multiple lightweight alloys, and it does not specifically investigate the effect of any post-processing treatment on ti-6al-4v's fatigue or mechanical performance; post-processing is only mentioned as a future direction. 系统评估waam在轻质合金（铝、钛、镁）中的研究进展 遵循prisma框架，对1052篇文献进行筛选和证据综合 揭示了工艺参数对微观组织和缺陷的控制作用，但未聚焦后处理 文献综述，无实验验证 wire arc additive manufacturing systematic review lightweight alloys ti-6al-4v process parameters wire arc additive manufacturing 丝材电弧增材制造 lightweight alloys 轻质合金 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v钛合金 process parameters 工艺参数 microstructure 微观组织 defects 缺陷 post-processing 后处理 agus widyianto, heri wibowo, riswan dwi djatmiko, atik setyani journal of automotive and mechanical applied technology universitas negeri yogyakarta, indonesia

blob: modelling and computational optimization of different neural network architectures for prediction of depth of cut in abrasive water jet machining of ti6al4v the current work presents an optimized neural network for predicting depth of cut (doc) in the abrasive water jet machining (awjm) of titanium ti6al4v grade 5 material. five process parameters were used for experimentation i.e., water pressure ( w p ), traverse speed ( t s ), nozzle to orifice diameter ( n/o dia ), abrasive mass flow rate ( a mf ), and abrasive orifice size ( a os ). experiments were carried out using the taguchi based l 27 orthogonal array, resulting in the development of a reg 本文研究的是ti6al4v的磨料水射流加工中切深预测的神经网络优化，未涉及后处理对疲劳或力学性能的影响，因此与用户方向（后处理对力学性能的影响）关联较弱。 this paper focuses on predicting depth of cut in abrasive water jet machining of ti6al4v, but does not study the effect of post-processing on mechanical performance (e.g., fatigue, tensile strength) or microstructural changes. 优化神经网络模型以精确预测ti6al4v磨料水射流加工的切深。 基于taguchi l27实验设计，使用单隐藏层和深度神经网络，比较四种激活函数。 深度神经网络结合高斯激活函数预测精度最高，测试rmse降低12.5%，r²提高4.2%。 通过sem观察加工表面形貌验证预测结果。 abrasive water jet machining ti6al4v depth of cut neural network process optimization abrasive water jet machining 磨料水射流加工 depth of cut 切深 neural network 神经网络 ti6al4v ti6al4v钛合金 activation function 激活函数 taguchi orthogonal array 田口正交数组 root mean squared error 均方根误差 coefficient of determination 决定系数 yakub iqbal mogul, jaimon dennis quadros, g. ganesan subramanian, prashanth thalambeti, ibtisam mogul scientific reports national centre for motorsport engineering, school of engineering and built environment, university of greater manchester, deane road, bolton, bl3 5ab, uk

blob: effect of repeated powder reuse on the quality and mechanical properties of ti-6al-4v fabricated by laser powder bed fusion this study evaluated the effect of repeated powder reuse on the quality and mechanical properties of ti-6al-4v fabricated by laser powder bed fusion. gas-atomized ti-6al-4v powder was repeatedly reused up to 15 build cycles, and changes in powder morphology, oxygen content, hardness, tensile properties, microstructure, and localized inclusions were examined. repeated reuse progressively degraded the initially spherical powder morphology, as evidenced by the increased presence of satellite partic 该论文直接研究了激光粉末床熔融ti-6al-4v粉末重复使用对力学性能的影响，属于l1方向的核心内容。 this paper does not model or predict mechanical/fatigue behavior; it provides only experimental characterization and a practical reuse limit based on oxygen and ductility. 评估lpbf ti-6al-4v粉末重复使用对制品质量与力学性能的影响。 将气体雾化ti-6al-4v粉末重复使用多达15次，检测粉末形貌、氧含量、硬度、拉伸性能及微观组织。 重复使用15次后硬度升至411 hv，伸长率从10.7%降至7.4%，氧含量超标，提出了6次重复使用上限。 通过硬度测试、拉伸试验、sem-eds和光学显微镜进行实验验证。 lpbf ti-6al-4v powder reuse mechanical properties oxygen content ductility hardness tensile strength laser powder bed fusion 激光粉末床熔融 powder reuse 粉末重复使用 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v mechanical properties 力学性能 oxygen content 氧含量 ductility 延展性 hardness 硬度 tensile strength 拉伸强度 jae h. kim, seong-jin park, hyomoon joo, jae‐keun hong journal of welding and joining lightweight materials research division, korea institute of materials science, changwon, 51508, korea

blob: multi-scale finite element simulation framework for deformation and damage of large structure under complex loadings this paper establishes a multi-scale nested sub-modeling finite element simulation framework for the deformation and damage analysis of large-scale structures under complex loading conditions. by sequentially transferring displacement solutions from the global model to local sub-models, the framework enables progressive high-resolution analysis from the macroscopic scale (>10 m) down to the microscopic scale (~1 μm), thereby significantly improving solution accuracy in critical regions while  该论文针对ti-6al-4v eli的疲劳寿命预测建立了多尺度有限元框架，直接符合方向要求。 no as-built mechanical property data reported; validation uses published experimental results. 开发适用于大型结构复杂载荷下变形与损伤分析的多尺度仿真框架 建立嵌套子模型有限元框架，从宏观至微观逐级传递位移解，结合晶体塑性方法和疲劳指示参数模型 壳体和裂纹板应力应变误差小于5%，ti-6al-4v eli剪切疲劳寿命预测误差低于10% 通过壳体静压实验和含裂纹板应力强度因子计算验证，并与ti-6al-4v eli疲劳实验数据对比 multi-scale simulation sub-modeling crystal plasticity fatigue life ti-6al-4v eli large-scale structure multi-scale simulation 多尺度模拟 sub-modeling 子模型方法 crystal plasticity finite element method 晶体塑性有限元法 fatigue indicator parameter 疲劳指示参数 ti-6al-4v eli ti-6al-4v eli fatigue life prediction 疲劳寿命预测 large-scale structure 大型结构 stress intensity factor 应力强度因子 cheng li, chengqi sun materials state key laboratory of nonlinear mechanics, institute of mechanics, chinese academy of sciences, beijing 100190, china

blob: machine learning and artificial intelligence in metallic orthopedic implant development: a narrative review background: metallic orthopedic implants face persistent clinical challenges that have proved resistant to incremental conventional development. machine learning and artificial intelligence offer a complementary paradigm for navigating the high-dimensional design spaces governing implant performance, yet the literature remains fragmented across disciplinary silos with no comprehensive synthesis spanning the full development pipeline. methods: a structured database search of pubmed/medline, embas 该论文为综述，涉及金属骨科植入物开发的机器学习方法，但未具体针对ti-6al-4v股骨柄的结构设计或力学性能。 this is a narrative review covering ml/ai in metallic implant development broadly, not a primary study on ti-6al-4v femoral stem design, fatigue, or experimental validation. 传统方法难以解决金属骨科植入物的临床挑战，需新范式加速开发。 对五个领域（合金成分、增材制造、多孔结构、表面工程、腐蚀磨损）的33项研究进行综述。 机器学习在性能预测和设计空间探索上显著加速，但面临数据小、缺乏外部验证等障碍。 无原始验证，基于文献汇总的模型性能指标。 machine learning metallic orthopedic implants additive manufacturing lattice design narrative review machine learning 机器学习 metallic orthopedic implant 金属骨科植入物 additive manufacturing 增材制造 lattice structure 点阵结构 property prediction 性能预测 bayesian optimization 贝叶斯优化 convolutional neural network 卷积神经网络 physics-informed neural network 物理信息神经网络 corrosion prediction 腐蚀预测 ti-6al-4v 钛合金 prajwal guruprasad, pranav sivaram, andrew cibik, pierce t. bombard, albert t. anastasio materials college of medicine, northeast ohio medical university, rootstown, oh 44272, usa

blob: influence of strut tapering and joint-node height on mechanical response of bcc lattices abstract this study investigates the tensile response of body-centered cubic (bcc) lattice structures with tapered struts manufactured from ti6al4v powder using a laser-beam powder bed fusion (pbf-lb) process. it quantifies how the end diameter $$(d_\textrm{end}$$ ), mid-span diameter $$(d_\textrm{mid}$$ ), and joint-node height $$(h)$$ affect young’s modulus $$(e$$ ), 0.2% proof stress $$(r_\mathrm{p0.2}$$ ), and ultimate tensile strength $$(r_\textrm{m}$$ ). experimental tensile tests performe 该论文研究ti6al4v点阵结构的力学性能，属于增材制造ti-6al-4v的力学表征，但未涉及疲劳性能。 focuses on lattice structures with tapered struts and static tensile properties only, no fatigue data or s-n curves. 研究变截面杆径和节点高度对bcc点阵结构力学响应的影响。 结合实验拉伸测试和有限元模拟，建立响应面回归模型。 中间直径和端部直径增大同时提高弹性模量和强度，节点高度影响次要且与几何相关。 实验验证了弹性及早期塑性阶段的预测，后峰值阶段偏差较大。 ti6al4v lattice structures pbf-lb mechanical properties finite element method regression models body-centered cubic (bcc) lattice 体心立方点阵 tapered struts 变截面杆 laser-beam powder bed fusion (pbf-lb) 激光粉末床熔融 young's modulus 杨氏模量 0.2% proof stress 0.2%屈服强度 ultimate tensile strength 极限抗拉强度 finite element method 有限元法 response surface regression 响应面回归 ti6al4v ti6al4v david liović, emanuele vaglio, federico scalzo, marina franulović, giovanni totis progress in additive manufacturing university of rijeka, faculty of engineering, vukovarska 58, 51000 rijeka, croatia

blob: enhancement of the wear and corrosion performance of laser powder bed fusion ti-6al-4v via in-situ laser surface remelting under a nitrogen atmosphere abstract laser powder bed fusion (lpbf) enables the fabrication of ti-6al-4v components with complex geometries for biomedical and aerospace applications; however, the as-built surfaces often require additional post-processing to meet wear and corrosion performance requirements. in this study, an in-situ nitrogen-assisted laser surface remelting step is integrated into the lpbf workflow to enhance near-surface performance without external coatings or secondary treatments. the effect of this proc 该论文直接研究了ti-6al-4v的后处理（激光表面重熔）对磨损和腐蚀性能的影响，属于l2方向的直接贡献。 the paper does not investigate fatigue or tensile properties, focusing instead on wear and corrosion performance. 改善激光粉末床熔融ti-6al-4v的耐磨和耐腐蚀性能 在lpbf过程中集成氮气辅助激光表面重熔步骤 磨损体积减少54%，纳米硬度提高18-22%，腐蚀电流密度降低14% 通过磨损测试、纳米压痕和电化学测量进行实验验证 laser powder bed fusion ti-6al-4v in-situ laser surface remelting nitrogen atmosphere wear resistance corrosion resistance surface modification laser powder bed fusion 激光粉末床熔融 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v in-situ laser surface remelting 原位激光表面重熔 nitrogen atmosphere 氮气气氛 wear resistance 耐磨性 corrosion resistance 耐腐蚀性 nanohardness 纳米硬度 grain refinement 晶粒细化 electron backscatter diffraction 电子背散射衍射 ankit porwal, santanu dhara, cheruvu siva kumar journal of tribology e3-309 ms hall iit kharagpur kharagpur, west bengal 721302 india

blob: investigating crystallographic parameters and their impact on mechanical properties of ti6al4v alloy from selective laser melting selective laser melting (slm) is a highly adaptable additive manufacturing method notable for its feature accuracy and flexibility. processing ti-6al-4v alloy using slm is particularly advantageous because of the alloy's unique structural features and thermal characteristics, making it well-suited for demanding applications where lightweight design, strength, and durability are essential. however, prohibitively large number of process parameters and complex thermo-physical phenomenon significant 该论文聚焦于激光选区熔化ti-6al-4v合金的晶体学参数与力学性能（拉伸和扭转），符合方向l1对增材制造ti-6al-4v力学性能的要求。 the paper does not address fatigue performance, s-n curves, or crack behavior, which are central to the fatigue focus of layer 1, though it covers tensile and torsional mechanical properties. 研究slm工艺参数对ti-6al-4v合金晶体结构及力学性能的影响。 通过xrd分析晶体尺寸和微应变，并进行拉伸和扭转力学测试。 水平方向拉伸和扭转屈服强度略高于垂直方向，结晶度在垂直方向更高。 实验力学测试与xrd表征验证了晶体参数与性能的关系。 slm ti-6al-4v crystallographic parameters mechanical properties xrd tensile strength torsional strength selective laser melting 激光选区熔化 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v crystallite size 晶粒尺寸 microstrain 微应变 x-ray diffraction x射线衍射 tensile strength 抗拉强度 torsional strength 扭转强度 crystallinity 结晶度 kidu gebrecherkos weldeanenia, janaki ramulu perumalla, samuel kinde kassegne proceedings of the institution of mechanical engineers part l journal of materials design and applications department of mechanical engineering, san diego state university, san diego, ca, usa

blob: laser powder bed fusion processing of ti-6al-4v powders with offsize and wide particle size distributions—process optimization the considerable expense associated with metal additive manufacturing (am), partly attributed to the high costs of raw materials, forms a significant obstacle hindering the widespread adoption and scaling of this technology. in response to this challenge, this study endeavors to explore and optimize the laser powder bed fusion (lpbf) process parameters for ti-6al-4v powders with offsize (45–106 µm) and wide (15–106 µm) particle size distribution (psd) which are more cost-effective. the outcomes  该论文研究了非标粒径ti-6al-4v粉末的lpbf工艺优化，提供了硬度、密度等基础力学性能数据，但与疲劳性能无直接关联。 this paper does not provide mechanical/fatigue properties such as tensile strength, ductility, or fatigue life; it focuses on process optimization for cost reduction rather than detailed mechanical characterization. 降低粉末成本，优化非标粒径ti-6al-4v粉末的lpbf工艺参数。 采用多步实验设计，优化轮廓-核心-表皮策略下的工艺参数，并对比标准粉末。 获得密度>99.9%、硬度~40 hrc、粗糙度9.5-15.7 μm的成形件。 通过密度、硬度、显微组织表征验证工艺可行性。 ti-6al-4v laser powder bed fusion particle size distribution process optimization hardness density surface roughness microstructure laser powder bed fusion 激光粉末床熔融 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v particle size distribution 粒径分布 process optimization 工艺优化 density 密度 hardness 硬度 surface roughness 表面粗糙度 microstructure 显微组织 hot isostatic pressing 热等静压 farzad liravi, mahyar hasanabadi, tatevik minasyan, pablo d. enrique, sebastian soo materials multi-scale additive manufacturing laboratory, department of mechanical and mechatronics engineering, university of waterloo, 200 university ave. w., waterloo, on n2l 3g1, canada

blob: sustainable and intelligent automation framework for aerospace alloys using multi-agent deep reinforcement learning advanced aerospace alloys such as titanium alloy (ti-6al-4v) are widely employed in critical applications owing to their excellent strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance. however, machining these alloys remains challenging due to significant tool wear, poor material removal rates, and surface integrity concerns. this research offers a sustainable and intelligent machining framework for a 3 mm thick ti-6al-4v alloy, utilizing coated wire electrical discharge machining (wedm) linked wit 该论文涉及ti-6al-4v但非增材制造，研究电火花加工而非后处理，与用户关注方向无关。 this paper studies wire edm machining of ti-6al-4v, not additive manufacturing or any post-processing treatment relevant to am ti-6al-4v mechanical performance. 针对航空航天合金加工难题，提出智能可持续加工框架。 结合涂层线电火花加工与多智能体深度强化学习，优化加工参数。 提高材料去除率，降低表面粗糙度和能耗。 通过box-behnken实验设计验证模型性能。 ti-6al-4v wire edm machining deep reinforcement learning sustainability wire electrical discharge machining 线放电加工 multi-agent deep reinforcement learning 多智能体深度强化学习 material removal rate 材料去除率 surface roughness 表面粗糙度 kerf width 切缝宽度 energy consumption 能耗 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v nagadeepan anbazhagan, v. senthilkumar, k. k. ilavenil automation department of mechanical engineering, srm trp engineering college, trichy 621105, tamil nadu, india

title: Microstructural gradients and associated mechanical and fatigue behavior in DED Ti-6Al-4V across the build height
authors: Andrea Školáková, Jan Pinc, Hana Lesáková et al.

title: Effects of Sandblasting at Different Angles Combined with Subsequent Acid Pickling on the Microstructure and Surface Properties of SLM-Formed Ti-6Al-4V Alloy
authors: Yu Xie, Lei Li
blob: effects of sandblasting at different angles combined with subsequent acid pickling on the microstructure and surface properties of slm-formed ti-6al-4v alloy ti-6al-4v alloy possesses excellent specific strength, corrosion resistance, and biocompatibility, rendering it widely applicable in aerospace, marine engineering and biomedical fields. selective laser melting (slm) serves as an effective technique for manufacturing complex ti-6al-4v components. however, slm-formed specimens generally suffer from surface defects such as high surface roughness, adhered powders, spheroidized particles, and localized spatter, which degrade their service performance 该论文主要研究slm成形ti-6al-4v合金的喷砂和酸洗后处理表面改性，而非基体力学或疲劳性能，与layer 1方向不直接相关。 the paper focuses on post-processing surface modification (sandblasting and acid pickling) rather than as-built mechanical/fatigue performance of ti-6al-4v. slm成形ti-6al-4v合金表面缺陷多，需有效表面改性。 系统研究不同角度喷砂联合酸洗对slm ti-6al-4v表面特性的影响。 喷砂角度显著影响材料去除和表面形貌，酸洗进一步降低粗糙度并改善润湿性。 通过sem、粗糙度、显微硬度等实验验证表面改性效果。 slm ti-6al-4v sandblasting acid pickling surface properties selective laser melting 选择性激光熔化 ti-6al-4v 钛合金 sandblasting 喷砂 acid pickling 酸洗 surface roughness 表面粗糙度 microhardness 显微硬度 residual stress 残余应力 yu xie, lei li micromachines school of mechanics and aeronautics, inner mongolia university of technology, aimin sub-district, xincheng district, hohhot 010051, china

title: On torsional behavior of 3D printed 17-4 PH-SS-Ni-625-Ti-6Al-4V compositionally graded structures with lattice interlayers for biomedical applications
authors: Bharat Kalia, Rupinder Singh, Rupinder Singh et al.
